text:
anya: Heads-up: planning a small holiday 'Thank Kits' drop for offices and remote opt-ins. Goal: postcard + tea sachet + sticker. Shipping week: Dec 5-9. Need vendor, pack day, opt-in, and PO.
rita: I'll scope local printers for SF, London, and SG. Prefer single-color print to save cost.
sam: I can handle packathon volunteers. Suggest Nov 29 afternoon.
leo: Do we want a QR that pre-fills a SpotAwards nomination? Could link to 'holiday-kit' tag.
finance-bot: Budget note: up to $60 per kit pre-approved under 'culture-kits' with PO. Above needs director sign-off.
mailroom-bot: Reminder: vendor deliveries require 48h prior logging and contact details.
legal: Consent required for addresses; template approved. Keep address data for 30 days then delete.
anya: Action items: Rita get quotes by Nov 10; Sam create volunteer signup by Nov 20; Leo produce QR + short copy; Finance to issue PO after quotes. Keep kit value under country thresholds for tax.
sam: Packathon Nov 29 13:00-16:00. Will post sign-up.
rita: Quote estimate: $1.95/kit SF, a32.20/kit UK local print, SG $3.10/kit. Will attach formal quotes tomorrow.
anya: Great, thanks. Keep messaging short and feel-good. We'll coordinate shipping opt-in for remote folks. :sparkles:
